scope.pick: All five, plus brand-new characters for the three themes that have none

new-expressions.pick: Other — happy and shut-down, not smug
new-expressions.note: AMENDED IN CHAT immediately after submitting, 2026-09-04: "actually lets just keep shut-down." The deck answer was 'Add only happy'. Read as happy + shutdown; smug was never asked for on its own and stays OUT unless he asks. SECOND HALF OF THE SAME MESSAGE, and it is a hold, not a decision: "i may want to workshop it a bit further though before we implement, i didn't entirely love the shut down pose as written." The shutdown FACE is settled; the shutdown POSE is not, and must not be built until he has picked one. See sleeping's note.

aliveness.pick: Reactions, plus spontaneous moments of his own
aliveness.note: i want a much richer idle/spontaneity, but the non-notifying movements should be subtle enough to be distinguished from a single clear "needs attention" animation when a session has a blue/red/yellow status light

sleeping.pick: Sleeps after a few quiet minutes, wakes on any activity
sleeping.note: BLOCKED ON THE POSE WORKSHOP (2026-09-04). Sleeping is what shows the shutdown pose, and the pose is unsettled — so the sleep behaviour is designed but not built until he picks one. The film's pose (engine `sitTuck`, storyboard-v3/sit-and-tuck.png) was authored for the END OF A VIDEO at large size beside the wordmark; the desktop case is 112px in a corner, persistent, must wake convincingly, and may be docked at a screen edge. Ten earlier candidates are on file in storyboard-v3/power-down-poses{,-2}.png.
